package main

// Throwaway snapshot generator for source-declarative's proof test. Copy it
// to golden_test.go in this connector's directory, run
//   GOLDEN_OUT=$PWD/../source-declarative/testdata/<proof> go test -run TestGolden -count=1 .
// and delete it again; it is not part of this connector.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	synclet "github.com/synclet-io/synclet-go-sdk"
	"github.com/synclet-io/synclet-go-sdk/testkit"
)

func TestGolden(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("GOLDEN_OUT")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip("GOLDEN_OUT not set")
	}
	for _, sub := range []string{"expected", "schemas"} {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(dir, sub), 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	srv, _ := fixtureServer(t, nil)
	src := testSource(srv, newClock())
	out, err := testkit.RunSource(t.Context(), src, synclet.Request{Command: synclet.CommandDiscover, Config: json.RawMessage(testConfig)})
	if err != nil || out.Err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err, out.Err)
	}
	cat := out.Catalog()
	writeJSON(t, filepath.Join(dir, "expected", "catalog.json"), cat)
	for _, s := range cat.Streams {
		var schema any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(s.JSONSchema, &schema); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		writeJSON(t, filepath.Join(dir, "schemas", s.Name+".json"), schema)
		golden(t, src, dir, s, synclet.SyncModeFullRefresh, "", "full_refresh")
	}
}

func golden(t *testing.T, src Source, dir string, s synclet.Stream, mode synclet.SyncMode, state, name string) {
	t.Helper()
	cat, err := json.Marshal(synclet.ConfiguredCatalog{Streams: []synclet.ConfiguredStream{{Stream: s, SyncMode: mode, DestinationSyncMode: synclet.DestinationSyncModeAppend}}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	req := synclet.Request{Command: synclet.CommandRead, Config: json.RawMessage(testConfig), Catalog: cat}
	if state != "" {
		req.State = json.RawMessage(state)
	}
	out, err := testkit.RunSource(t.Context(), src, req)
	if err != nil || out.Err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err, out.Err)
	}
	f, err := os.Create(filepath.Join(dir, "expected", s.Name+"."+name+".jsonl"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer f.Close()
	enc := json.NewEncoder(f)
	for _, m := range out.Messages {
		switch m.Type {
		case synclet.MessageTypeRecord:
			err = enc.Encode(map[string]any{"type": "RECORD", "data": m.Record.Data})
		case synclet.MessageTypeState:
			err = enc.Encode(map[string]any{"type": "STATE", "state": m.State})
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}

func writeJSON(t *testing.T, path string, v any) {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
